title: A sensor is not an authority.
hook: Fast typed judgment can feed triage. It can never authorize an effect.
thesis: Jev is a shadow sensor, never an authority. Its typed answers feed triage, routing, and escalation, but nothing Jev returns decides whether an effect is authorized. The kernel decides, and tenant identity never goes to the provider. The strongest version of this post names the exact point where Jev's output stops and the kernel's decision starts.

verified: Jev is a shadow sensor, NEVER an authority; nothing Jev returns decides whether an effect is authorized (MEMORY.md Jev posture; SYSTEMS.md section 6).
